description: This file defines the ConfigureKubernetesHostingOptions class, which implements various configuration interfaces for setting up Kubernetes hosting options within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for configuring cluster, silo, and endpoint options, as well as reading environment variables and network information specific to Kubernetes environments.

classes.name: ConfigureKubernetesHostingOptions
classes.description: Implements configuration interfaces to set up Kubernetes-specific options for Orleans hosting, including environment variable reading, network address selection, and post-configuration of endpoints.

classes.name: IPAddressSelector
classes.description: A static nested class within ConfigureKubernetesHostingOptions that provides logic to select an appropriate IP address from a list of candidates based on private IP ranges and preferences.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures KubernetesHostingOptions by setting namespace, pod name, and pod IP from environment variables or system information.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures ClusterOptions with ServiceId and ClusterId from environment variables.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures SiloOptions with the pod name from KubernetesHostingOptions.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Post-configuration of EndpointOptions, setting advertised IP address, silo listening endpoint, and gateway listening endpoint based on environment and DNS resolution.

methods.name: ReadNamespaceFromServiceAccount
methods.description: Reads the Kubernetes namespace from the service account file in the container.
